title: Implement role-oriented Home and Classes destinations
verify: FT-007-AC-002: /home and /classes consume server-resolved actor and Center & Scheduling scope to present Admin own-center, Teacher assigned-class, and Student/Parent accessible-calendar destinations.
Unauthenticated, revoked, cross-center, cross-class, non-member, and removed-assignment requests fail before protected destination data renders.
Both routes are read-only adapters, never reconstruct provider scope, and pass their own disposable browser role/scope matrix.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-002 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: /home or /classes trusts client scope, omits an allowed destination, exposes unauthorized center/class data, or permits removed assignment; GREEN: focused route and owned-server browser tests prove both canonical routes, the full role/scope matrix, safe denial, and non-mutation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-080-T3-FT-007-W29/ and .protocols/TASK-080-T3-FT-007-W29/.
purpose: Deliver the accepted Home/Classes role-oriented navigation outcome as one server-scoped implementation result.
success_outcome: Each supported role can open /home and /classes and see only the center/class destinations currently authorized by server boundaries.
anti_goals: Do not implement Statistics, Profile, or provider formulas.
Do not read Center & Scheduling tables directly from routes.
Do not add a role, membership, assignment, or client authority.
constraints: Both pages are thin adapters over the same server-resolved destination scope and together own AC-002.
The existing class calendar and class-entry routes remain destination owners.
Browser proof reuses TASK-079's executable runner but proves only this task's role/scope result.
invariants: Server actor, center membership, class membership, and assignment are decisive.
Removed assignment is denied at the next request without unrelated data disclosure.
Home and Classes add no writes or provider-table access.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-002: Admin/Teacher/Student/Parent positive destinations plus cross-center/class, non-member, revoked, and removed-assignment negatives on both routes.

stop_conditions: Stop if either route requires a new public query, role, membership, assignment, or authorization contract.
Stop if route code must read provider tables or browser proof cannot remain disposable.
